title: carya aquatica
intro: Carya aquatica, commonly known as water hickory or swamp hickory, is a deciduous tree native to the southeastern United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Carya aquatica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Carya aquatica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
